note: Small family-run campground in a wooded valley 10 minutes east of Decorah, across the road from Trout River (a state-stocked trout stream and wildlife area). Tent sites by a spring-fed stream; a furnished farmhouse rents year-round; deer and turkey hunting packages. No cell signal reported by campers. --Claude
summary: DROP CANDIDATE on Google reviews (3.8 from 41, AWH 2026-11-02 rule). Rate set from the operator's rate list ($28-30 water+electric, previously unstored; undated page, matched by 2023-2025 camper reports). Added 50-amp; cleared note-derived sewer (site names water+electric only, every camper says no sewer), dump (a 2024 Google review says there is none) and laundry (not on the operator's pages). Showers confirmed.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviews): Google Maps 3.8 stars from 41 reviews - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews on that site, which AWH 2026-11-02 set as a drop for a private park with no --AWH note (this entry has none). Against it: RV Life 4 stars, five 2023-2025 RV Life reviews rated 8-10 ('Down to earth owners, well maintained sites, very accomodating', 5/2024). The Google reviews I could read (limited view, 5 of 41) were all 5/5, so the low average comes from reviews I couldn't see.

PRIVATE GATE: $28-30 posted (undated, © 2008 site), campers paid $26-33 2023-2025 - well under $50; no gateway needed (nearest Wisconsin Dells 158 km). Good Sam not checked as a Good Sam Park; no GS claim on the operator's pages. RV Life 4 stars, $$ (avg $27).
PRESENCE: working operator website with phone (563) 382-4849 and cell (563) 379-7222; Google open with 41 reviews and the same phone. Passes.

LONG-STAY: (1) nightly rates posted on the operator's own page - test 2 passes; (2) a 2024 Google review: 'Lots of friendly people who stay set up all season.' - some seasonal campers, but campers book single nights ('Called last minute on a Friday morning', 'Spent 2 nights here'); no monthly/seasonal rate posted, no homes or lots sold. Not mostly seasonal in my reading; passes.

FACILITIES: Google review (Keisha Caetano, ~2 years ago): 'They currently do not have a dump station or garbage dumpster on site. We took ours to Waukon Campground'; another: 'No trash service. showers were dated but very clean.' Dump cleared accordingly.

SITES: stored count 30 and pull_through came from note prose; the operator's pages give no count. An RV Life reviewer (8/2025): '10 sites have 30amp service and water.. all others are electric only' - so water may not be at every site. Left alone, unverified.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Imagery shows the RV loop in an open, tree-dotted field between the county road and the wooded hillside; Trout River is across the road.
PIN: stored 43.26254,-91.65946 sits on the entrance lane south of the loop; the site loop centre is ~43.2636,-91.6597 (~125 m north). Under 250 m, no change needed.
